description:
Export a double-entry reconciled financial statement with SHA-256 checksum covering Stripe top-ups, spends, refunds, and delegate attribution. Use this for accounting audits and date-range reporting; do not use for live balances (x402_get_account) or active key caps (x402_list_delegate_keys).
Parameters: start_date/end_date are inclusive UTC filters (reconciliation spans full ledger); master may filter by delegate_id while delegates see own rows only; supply spend_key/header (mismatch -> HTTP 400).
Behavior: zero charge; HTTP 401 invalid/revoked key, 120 req/min/IP.

delegate_id.description: Unique delegated subagent key identifier returned by x402_issue_delegate_key or x402_get_account (format: sbd_<16 hex chars>, e.g. sbd_1122334455667788).

end_date.description: UTC calendar date in ISO-8601 YYYY-MM-DD format (e.g. 2026-11-22).

spend_key.description: Stripe-funded master or delegated subagent spend key (format: sbk_<43+ chars>). Optional when the caller supplies the x-atlas-spend-key HTTP header.

start_date.description: UTC calendar date in ISO-8601 YYYY-MM-DD format (e.g. 2026-11-22).

name: x402_export_statement

ok.description: True when the reconciled statement was generated.

balanced.description: True when computed double-entry closing balance matches the ledger balance exactly.

row_count.description: Number of chronological ledger entries included in rows.

rows.description: Chronological ledger entries with USD amounts, routes, payment identifiers, and delegate attribution.

statement_sha256.description: Tamper-evident SHA-256 checksum of the statement payload.

title: Export Reconciled Financial Statement
